posts.title: We're All in This Together: Reflections on UTW 2026
posts.description: By Kyra Ann Dawkins, Script Encoding Initiative (SEI) It was such a privilege to be a co-host of UTW as part of the Script Encoding Initiative this year. I think there is something undeniably special about seeing months of planning come to fruition, from seeing room maps to actually being in the rooms surrounded by vibrant discussions. posts.description: Unicode CLDR 49 is now available and has been integrated into version ICU 79 and ICU4X 2.4 . posts.title: ICU 79 Released
posts.description: Unicode® ICU 79 has just been released. ICU is the premier library for software internationalization , used by a wide array of companies and organizations to support the world's languages, implementing both the latest version of the Unicode Standard and of the Unicode locale data (CLDR).
